# WGC (Waypoint Gateway Collective)

> Fundraising, payments, and donor management platform for mission-driven organizations — nonprofits, churches and ministries, foundations, associations, schools, and government/community organizations. WGC processes card, ACH, Apple Pay, and Google Pay donations with a flat-rate fee structure (card capped at 2.3% + $0.25, ACH a flat 25¢, plus a $10/month platform fee that includes donor management, recurring giving, reporting, settlements, refunds, statements, and team accounts). WGC also partners with software platforms (ChMS, CRM, and nonprofit SaaS products) to embed this payment infrastructure, white-labeled, into their own products.

## Pricing & comparison

- [Pricing](https://www.wgcpayments.com/pricing): Full fee structure — card, ACH, and platform fee rates, plus a savings calculator.
- [Compare](https://www.wgcpayments.com/compare): WGC vs. Tithe.ly, Pushpay, Givebutter, Subsplash, Givelify, Donorbox, Planning Center Giving, Vanco Faith, and Breeze ChMS — card rate, ACH rate, and monthly platform fee side by side, with sources.
- [Switch to WGC](https://www.wgcpayments.com/switch): Migrating donor data, giving history, and organization records from another platform.
